name: Landmine Chest Press
cues: Hold the end of the bar with both hands at your upper chest
Take a split stance and lean slightly into the bar
Press up and forward until your arms are straight
Lower the bar back to your chest under control

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Arms are symmetric, trunk leans 15.5 deg into the bar (so the cue does read), press goes to straight arms along the arc, and the stance is still. At the bottom, though, the grip centres stop 17 cm in front of the sternum site (y 1.34 vs 1.28), so the fists sit about 12 cm off the chest. That is short of 'lower the bar back to your chest' (LANDMINE_PRESS.two.ahead 0.30). The hero at az -75 is nearly the same as the side view and shows the primary pec only in profile.
